review.reviewed_by: Culture Atlas graph-corpus domain review (PR 8 discovery)
review.basis: Every evidence entry was verified against its cited public source on 2026-10-28: The Art Institute of Chicago collection API v1.16 responses (each structured_value holds the exact non-description fields the API returned for that object) and the Wikipedia REST page summary for Bedroom in Arles (extract quoted verbatim, page revision 1374251357). The AIC API response states that all non-description data in the response is licensed CC0 1.0; the AIC open-access policy additionally releases object-page caption metadata under CC0. Wikipedia text is CC BY-SA 4.0 and every excerpt carries its attribution.
review.notes: Assertions state only what the cited metadata supports: CREATED_BY only for a named artist/designer in artist_display (works by unattributed makers, such as the Iznik tankard, the Moche portrait vessel, the Biedermeier desk and the Wikipedia-series Bedroom note, carry no invented creator), USES_TECHNIQUE from medium_display, HAS_ATTRIBUTE from style_title, DOCUMENTED_ASSOCIATION (on_display_at) from the museum's own gallery record. ABOUT and AUDIENCE_AFFINITY are deliberately absent from this pilot: it has no reviewed public-source evidence for those predicates, and no visual-resemblance claim of any kind ships here.

photo_candidate_inventory.location: Mission research directory (outside this repository): research/photo-candidates.json
photo_candidate_inventory.note: The 40-entry candidate photo inventory (30 Art Institute of Chicago metadata-reviewed entries and 10 unreviewed Wikimedia Commons interiors) is evaluation-planning material only. It is NOT a qualified blind or holdout evaluation set, NOT reviewed for photographic usefulness, and NEVER becomes graph evidence or corpus content. Photo-analysis model roles remain unqualified and fail closed.

provider_policy.note: Qloo responses remain transient under the existing adapter semantics (only ids, names and ranks for traceability are stored in provider_queries). Qloo-derived material is never admitted as durable evidence or displayed assets while Qloo's response-retention and public-display rights are undocumented; see the provider_rights_policies record (migration 300) and docs/graph-corpus.md.
